_comment: Mathematical role of every theorem-like blueprint entry (rule 8 of docs/blueprint_style_guide.md).
Entries are keyed by label; the chapter grouping only organizes this file and the reports of scripts/blueprint_roles.py, so moving an entry to another chapter needs no change here.
A label under 'theorems' is a main result of its chapter, a label under 'corollaries' a direct consequence of one; every other theorem-like entry is a lemma.
Each kept theorem carries a one-line reason under 'notes'. Apply with: python3 scripts/blueprint_roles.py --apply
